blocks.text: A pick and roll is an action where a teammate screens the ball handler’s defender, then moves toward the basket. Defensive responses include switching, dropping and showing help; the best choice depends on personnel and spacing.

blocks.text: PPG and APG are points and assists per valid appearance. Shooting percentages use summed makes and attempts, rather than averaging game percentages. A research sample filter is separate from NBA leader qualification.
